author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** Extend EvidenceWorker::run loop: in addition to draining 'pending', also drain 'failed' rows where attempt_count < MAX_ATTEMPTS (config) AND enqueued_at + backoff(attempt_count) < now(). Backoff: 2^attempt * 30s base, capped at 24h, ±25% jitter. Need migration 21 to add last_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ + max_attempts INT to evidence_jobs (or just compute attempt_count-driven schedule from enqueued_at). Tests: failed job becomes due after backoff window; retry succeeds → status=done; max-attempts reached → status stays failed permanently.
